documentation.content: Runbook row: Job failure and missed schedule (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md; c410, coordinated with RECOVERY-RETENTION.md). Responder: on-call API responder. A Cloud Run Jobs.RunJob system-event audit entry at ERROR or higher, for any job in this project. The job_name extraction gives each job its own incident timeline; the policy-wide daily incident/notification caps still apply. This signal includes the 19 archived purge executions that failed before a task started and wrote no completed_execution_count. Historical failures after task start and cancellation were not observed: retain the native job-failure metric policies as complementary signals. A successful scheduler HTTP request only acknowledges dispatch. Auto-close after 30 minutes without a matching entry is administrative cleanup, not proof the job recovered. Five-minute notification spacing and 30-minute auto-close are initial operating choices. Disabled, channel-free API acceptance alone does not prove evaluator behavior or responder delivery. See the runbook for activation and evidence requirements.

conditions.displayName: Cloud Run Jobs.RunJob ERROR system event

conditionMatchedLog.filter: logName="projects/{{PROJECT}}/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fsystem_event" AND resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND protoPayload.methodName="/Jobs.RunJob" AND severity>=ERROR
